authorization: Gabe: no approver or executor; one joint pick per entry; weekly/cumulative spread and total scorecards with live and paper combined and separate
decisions: New joint entries use picked or declined; class is live or paper. No approver, executor, or execution-confirmed fields. Book identity remains required for frozen quote and CLV attribution.
Both current pick logs contained headers only; exact original bytes archived before schema update. No historic picks or frozen experiments modified.
One row per joint pick ID within its class; duplicate IDs within a class fail, distinct live and paper records stay distinct even if IDs match.
Declined rows remain visible but do not count as bets or enter mean CLV. Unsettled picked rows are pending.
Final home/away scores include overtime; exact integer line equality is a push, half-point lines cannot push against integer scores.

CLV averages use available exact-line executed-book closing grades, not zeros for missing closes. Each grade must match class, ID and frozen quote/book/event/side/line/price. CLV sample size is explicit.
Cumulative covers all supplied seasons. Weekly rows are keyed by season and week, with combined/live/paper for each market.
outputs/scorecard.csv is a regenerable current report, with labeled per-pick details and hashed-input receipt. No data fetching or scheduling added.

verification.fixture_scope: unit tests only; no synthetic entries in live outputs
